name: MailSession_Run
evidence: Mail send/receive transfer screen once connected: 'sending'/'receiving' banner, MM:SS timer, B=cancel, drives the bank-54 SMTP/POP3 steps, results in WRAM1 D624-D637; far-called by 27:40D7; executed in mail_send/mail_receive

name: MailSession_SendPhase
evidence: send phase, skipped (jp z,$44F5 at 26:4129) when Mail_OutboxIsEmpty; runs bank-54 wrappers 54:44FE/451B, 54:4575/4772, 54:4538/4552 (SMTP-range API $14-$1A), sets D624; executed in mail_send/mail_errors, not in mail_receive

name: MailSession_ReceivePhase
evidence: receive phase: clears the message (5873), banner 'receiving' (56DB), bank-54 steps 54:485C/489B (API $1E), then the per-mail loops from 26:45BC; executed in mail_receive, mail_send (empty mailbox) and mail_errors

name: MailSession_ScanMailsLoop
evidence: first per-mail loop of the receive phase: for each of the N mails (HL counter) 26:4F7B, 54:4914/4969 (a=$FF), counts the ones answering 2 in BC, stores counts at D625/D62F; executed only in mail_receive-type runs

name: MailSession_ReceiveMailsLoop
evidence: second per-mail loop: draws 'ぜんぶで N つう / N つうめ' (26:537C), bank-54 steps 54:4914/4969 and 54:4CB0/4CF4, updates the received count D625 and stops when D62E + count == 12; executed in mail_receive

name: MailSession_NoMailOrFull
evidence: nothing to store: if Mailbox_CountRecords == 12 shows 'メールは うけとれませんでした' (57EB) else 'メールは ありませんでした' (57A7), then the closing animation; executed in mail_send/tutorial_profile (empty POP3 box)

name: MailSession_Finish
evidence: normal end: bank-04 request 00:20AC id $3D, final sprite animation, 7F:72B0 / 4F:4370 cleanup, returns A=0; reached from the message paths 26:4A61/4B02; executed in mail_send/mail_receive

name: Function_26_4C94
evidence: idea: sets sprite slot DA40 to one of 12 object rows 28:74CB.. chosen by the received-mail count [D625] (0-11, else 28:757B); called after each received mail; executed in mail_receive

name: Function_26_4DAB
evidence: idea: like 26:4C94 but for slot DA60 with objects 28:73FB.. chosen by [D625]+1 ($FF -> first row); executed in mail_receive

name: MailSession_CheckTimeWarning
evidence: Connection-time check: if timer A (C2D6 min, C2D5 s) reaches the next warning point [C26E] min + 30 s (9,19,..,69) shows the warning dialog via 7F:624F/6218; A=$FF if the user ends the session else 0; executed in 7 scenarios

name: MailSession_CheckTimeWarningRecv
evidence: Same time-warning test as MailSession_CheckTimeWarning used in the receive loop: after the dialog it redraws the 'receiving' banner (26:56DB); A=$FF ends the session, else 0; executed in 6 scenarios

name: MailSession_Cancel
evidence: B pressed (hJoyPressed/held bit1) during the transfer: 7F:72B0, 4F:4370, LCDC bit2 off, sets D637=1 (aborted) and returns A=$7F; executed in monkey_camp_reg/reg2/rich

name: MailSession_ShowCommError
evidence: Copies the adapter result C1DD/C1DE/C1DF to C272/C273/C274, sets D629=$FFFF, WX=7, LCD window off, farcalls 68:4F8C (error number screen), returns A=$80; executed in mail_errors/mail_timeout

name: MailSession_PollAdapterError
evidence: Returns NZ (A=1) unless bit1 of wTimerEnable is set; if set: 54:4011 (MobileAPI 0 = get last result into C1DD-C1DF) and returns Z so callers jump to MailSession_ShowCommError; executed in 6 scenarios

name: MailSession_ShowCommErrorNoWindow
evidence: Variant of MailSession_ShowCommError (26:5067) that sets WX=0 instead of 7; called at 26:42EE after a failed bank-54 receive step, then C1DD ($26 timeout / $30) decides whether to continue; executed in mail_errors

name: Function_26_5106
evidence: idea: compares (D629-D627) with (D62F-D631) (16-bit counters kept as one's complement) and returns A=1 with D631=D62F when equal, else 0; progress test of the receive loop; executed in mail_receive

name: MailSession_InitScreen

name: MailSession_DrawNumber
